name: Untold Stories 9: Castlemania
summary:
The ninth installment of the Untold Stories series by renderXR.
Assault dangerous castles with arcane wands.
Explore grand landscapes with mystery around every corner.
Uncover the secrets that haunt the forlorn towers.

In this monstrosity you will explore a large single environment you will travel from castle to castle to collect all the wool.
Mechanically, this is a follow-up of Nova Arcana, with the soul star system and healing flask, additionally, it expands on it via wands to spice up the gameplay.
